zh.title: 澳洲航空於A321XLR客機推出帶門廣體級商務艙套房
zh.summary: 澳洲航空於A321XLR配置帶門商務套房；平躺座椅樹立機隊新標準
body: 澳洲航空（Qantas）在單走道空中巴士 A321XLR（Airbus A321XLR）客機上，配置了具備隱私門戶的廣體客機等級商務艙套房。這項全新客艙產品將過往多見於雙走道廣體客機的套房規格，導入至窄體客機機型中。
該款客艙座椅配備平躺式商務艙套房功能，為搭乘窄體客機的旅客提供具備個人門戶的獨立空間。澳洲航空透過在此款空中巴士 A321XLR 客機導入此類高規格商務艙設計，提升了單走道客機的客艙配備與服務體驗。
根據 Simple Flying 報導，澳洲航空推出的這款新型平躺式商務艙產品，不僅重新定義了窄體機隊的座椅標準，也對其廣體機隊未來的客艙設計與服務品質樹立了全新的期待。

en.title: Qantas Unveils Widebody-Grade Business Suites With Doors on Airbus A321XLR
en.summary: Qantas installs widebody-grade business suites on Airbus A321XLR; new lie-flat product sets fleet expectations
body: Qantas has installed widebody-grade business class suites with privacy doors on its narrowbody Airbus A321XLR aircraft. The new premium seating option introduces lie-flat business suites—features traditionally associated with twin-aisle widebody aircraft—to the single-aisle plane model.

The lie-flat business class product offers passengers on the narrowbody aircraft individual suites equipped with closed doors. By introducing this suite design aboard its Airbus A321XLR fleet, Qantas enhances the overall cabin configuration and passenger experience on narrowbody routes.

According to Simple Flying, the airline's new lie-flat business class seat layout raises expectations for single-aisle cabin comfort. The door-equipped suites also establish a new benchmark and elevated expectations for Qantas' widebody fleet moving forward.

zh.title: 美國航空據報因座椅控制故障暫停開放A321XLR商務套房
zh.summary: 據報導，美國航空因座椅控制系統故障，暫停開放部分A321XLR客機商務套房。
body: 據 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空（American Airlines）據報正封鎖旗下空中巴士 A321XLR 客機上的部分 Flagship Suites 商務艙套房。相關報導指出，這項措施是因為套房的座椅控制系統頻繁出現故障，造成平躺座椅卡住無法正常切換或調整。
相關報導提到，在座椅控制系統多次發生異常問題後，美國航空已有數個 Flagship Suites 商務艙套房被迫暫停開放使用。相關設備故障直接影響平躺座椅的正常功能，航空公司因而決定暫時封鎖這些受影響的套房空間。

en.title: American Airlines Reportedly Sidelining A321XLR Business Suites Over Faulty Seat Controls
en.summary: American Airlines reportedly blocks A321XLR Flagship Suites due to faulty seat controls leaving lie-flat seats stuck.
body: American Airlines is reportedly blocking multiple Flagship Suites on its Airbus A321XLR aircraft following repeated seat control malfunctions. According to a report by Simple Flying, recurring control system glitches have left the premium lie-flat seats stuck in place, preventing passengers from adjusting their seating positions during flights.

As a result of these persistent control issues, several business class suites across the carrier's Airbus A321XLR fleet have been sidelined and temporarily removed from service. American Airlines has reportedly chosen to block these affected suites from customer use to prevent further operational disruptions while the underlying seat control failures are addressed.

zh.title: 宿霧太平洋航空接收今年第三架A320neo 機隊77%為NEO
zh.summary: 宿霧太平洋航空接收第三架A320neo；NEO占比達77%
body: 宿霧太平洋航空（Cebu Pacific）已接收2026年第三架空中巴士A320neo（ICAO機型代碼A20N），屬其機隊更新計畫的一部分。
該機於2026年9月11日由空中巴士位於中國天津的設施交付至馬尼拉，是該航空公司今年預定接收四架A320neo中的第三架。
航空公司表示，預計至年底共接收七架NEO機隊（涵蓋A320與A321機型）。
宿霧太平洋航空總裁暨商務長Xander Lao表示，此交付反映航空公司引進更省油、更具彈性的新世代飛機的目標。
目前NEO機隊占宿霧太平洋航空噴射客機機隊的77%，其營運機隊包括14架空中巴士A330、27架A321、38架A320及20架ATR渦輪螺旋槳飛機。

en.title: Cebu Pacific takes delivery of third A320neo for 2026; NEO share hits 77%
en.summary: Cebu Pacific takes third A320neo delivery for 2026; NEO share reaches 77%
body: Cebu Pacific has taken delivery of its third Airbus A320neo (ICAO type code A320) for 2026, as part of its fleet renewal program. The aircraft was delivered to Manila on September 11, 2026, from Airbus' facility in Tianjin, China.

It is the third of four A320neos scheduled for delivery to the Philippine carrier this year, with the airline expecting a total of seven NEO aircraft by year-end across both its A320 and A321 variants.

Cebu Pacific President and Chief Commercial Officer Xander Lao said the delivery reflects the airline's focus on bringing in newer, more fuel-efficient aircraft that offer greater flexibility across its network.
With the latest addition, NEO aircraft now account for 77% of Cebu Pacific's jet fleet, and the carrier operates 14 Airbus A330s, 27 Airbus A321s, 38 Airbus A320s, and 20 ATR turboprop aircraft.
